fields.note: Kindy uses a 45-ft base layout and 35-ft pitching distance on the Tee Ball field.

format.value: coaches pitch to their own team from one knee, up to about 6 pitches (kid dependent), then the ball goes on the tee; everyone bats each half-inning; no walks, no strikeouts, no bunts or half-swings; a ball must go 10 feet and stay fair for runners to advance; runners can be called out but outs aren't counted; no stealing, leading off or sliding; up to 11 fielders (max 5 outfielders), no catcher (the pitcher covers home), positions rotate; soft tee-ball safety balls; 45-ft bases, 35-ft pitching distance; no new inning after 45 minutes
format.note: Rules are a hybrid of tee ball and coach pitch and the coaches adapt them through the season.
format.source: Kindy Coach Pitch Division Meeting Spring 2026 (coaches' meeting doc, Drive Coaches/Tee Ball-Kindy Coaches Meeting) (Kindergarten Coach Pitch Rules); Baseball Hub Kindy card

For 2026, Sports Connect has the Round 2 (Jun 9) and final-day (Jun 12) games between NCLL teams, matching Maxwell's sheet; Round 1 (Mon Jun 8) is only in Maxwell's sheet. The Jun 15 and 17 rows in Sports Connect are 'TBD vs TBD' placeholder slots (3 of 4 with no program), not games: Maxwell's sheet has those fields as All-Star practices.

format.value: kid pitch, and at ball four a coach pitches to that batter (4 coach pitches; no walks); official hardball; an inning ends at 3 outs, 5 runs, or once through the batting order; one base on an error; no infield fly and no dropped-third-strike; no stealing in the first half of the season, then only on passed balls, wild pitches or a dropped return throw, never home; no mercy rule (play to the time limit); 90 minutes or 6 innings; score kept, playoffs end the season

umpires.value: AA provides its own umpires from the teams: the home team supplies the plate (chief) umpire and the visiting team the field umpire. If none is available, the home team provides one, who calls from behind the pitcher if without gear.

canadianGame.value: The AA Canadian game: the late-summer 9's game, a one-day event for strong league-age 9's from AA and AAA (not All-Stars).
canadianGame.detail: Also called the 9's game or 9's tournament/jamboree. Started a few years before 2024. In 2024 the coordinators polled AAA coaches with 9's, then AA coaches for recommended 9's. 2026 description: a group assembled in late summer to play a 4-team, one-day jamboree at NAF toward the end of August.

placement.detail: Assessments required, around Sat 2027-01-23, no make-up date. Registering doesn't guarantee a spot: 9's fill remaining roster spots by assessment score, with eligibility finalized in late January; 9's not drafted to AAA play AA. Coaches draft from the scores; order drawn from a hat; coaches' kids placed by score. Siblings: a team that drafts one sibling gets the other with its next pick. Highly skilled 8's are placed here only rarely, if roster needs dictate (kept by Cole in the final 2027 Age Matrix, Oct 30).

practices.detail: Once games start, Wednesday practices mostly disappear (games take those nights) and Monday practices stay. From late April, makeup games get the Lower Woodland time first and practices move to Bitter Lake, about 1-2 per team (2026). A AAA practice coordinator collects requests on a sheet and splits open slots fairly (names drawn from a hat when needed). Saturday practices when a team has no game.

playoffs.detail: 2026: Tue 5/26 (2 games), Wed 5/27 (2), Fri 5/29 (1), Sat 5/30 (3), Mon 6/1 (2 consolation), Wed 6/3 championship at 6pm plus the 3rd-place game. Matchups were set as results came in; four first-round games suggest all 8 teams play. Seeding method not found. In playoffs every player plays at least 3 innings in the field, including 1 in the infield (6-inning game). 2025 ('2025 AAA BB Playoff Game Schedule', 9 games): Sat May 31 (3), Mon Jun 2 (3), Thu Jun 5 (1), Sat Jun 7 (2), at Lower Woodland and one at Eagle Staff.
